g.text: Primary result: 4,096-token prefill 135.97 → 105.88 ms | 22.1% lower latency | 1.284× speedup
Decode bars: paired 95% bootstrap intervals (within-session uncertainty). All span parity; no causal decode regression established.
The strict mean no-regression gate still failed at 256 tokens. No serving-throughput improvement or adoption claimed.
